#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Claude Code status line. Requires jq.
set -u

# Claude Code sends one JSON object to stdin on every refresh.
IFS=$'\t' read -r model effort ctx hit used5 reset5 used7 reset7 < <(
  jq -r '
    def percent:
      if type == "number" then ([0, ([100, .] | min)] | max | round)
      else "NA" end;
    [
      (.model.display_name // "Unknown"),
      (.effort.level // "N/A"),
      (.context_window.used_percentage | percent),
      (.prompt_cache.hit_ratio | if type == "number" then (. * 100 | round) else "NA" end),
      (.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage | percent),
      (.rate_limits.five_hour.resets_at // "NA"),
      (.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage | percent),
      (.rate_limits.seven_day.resets_at // "NA")
    ] | @tsv
  '
)

RESET=$'\033[0m'
DIM=$'\033[2m'
MODEL_COLOR=$'\033[1;35m'
CYAN=$'\033[36m'
SEPARATOR=$'\033[38;2;130;130;130m'
TRACK=$'\033[38;2;120;120;120m'
GREEN=$'\033[32m'
YELLOW=$'\033[33m'
RED=$'\033[31m'

percent_text() {
  if [[ $1 =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then printf '%d%%' "$1"; else printf '%s' '--%'; fi
}

left_text() {
  if [[ $1 =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then printf '%d%%' "$((100 - $1))"; else printf '%s' '--%'; fi
}

reset_after() {
  local ts=$1 seconds days hours mins
  if [[ ! $ts =~ ^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$ ]]; then printf '%s' '--'; return; fi
  seconds=$(( ${ts%%.*} - NOW ))
  (( seconds < 0 )) && seconds=0
  days=$((seconds / 86400))
  hours=$(((seconds % 86400) / 3600))
  mins=$(((seconds % 3600) / 60))
  if (( days > 0 )); then
    printf '%dd %dh' "$days" "$hours"
  elif (( hours > 0 )); then
    printf '%dh %dm' "$hours" "$mins"
  else
    printf '%dm' "$mins"
  fi
}

# Gradient uses stable, full-width block characters: no fractional glyphs.
context_bar() {
  local pct=$1 width=20 filled=0 i pos r g b offset
  if [[ $pct =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then filled=$(((pct * width + 50) / 100)); fi
  for ((i = 0; i < width; i++)); do
    if (( i >= filled )); then
      printf '%sâ' "$TRACK"
      continue
    fi
    pos=$((i * 100 / (width - 1)))
    if ((pos <= 50)); then
      r=$(( 0 + 220 * pos / 50 ))
      g=200
      b=$(( 80 - 80 * pos / 50 ))
    else
      offset=$((pos - 50))
      r=220
      g=$(( 200 - 160 * offset / 50 ))
      b=$(( 20 * offset / 50 ))
    fi
    printf '\033[38;2;%d;%d;%dmâ' "$r" "$g" "$b"
  done
  printf '%s' "$RESET"
}

usage_color() {
  if [[ ! $1 =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( $1 < 70 )); then printf '%s' "$GREEN"
  elif (( $1 < 90 )); then printf '%s' "$YELLOW"
  else printf '%s' "$RED"; fi
}

NOW=$(date +%s)
ctx_label=$(percent_text "$ctx")
hit_label=$(percent_text "$hit")
five_left=$(left_text "$used5")
seven_left=$(left_text "$used7")
five_reset=$(reset_after "$reset5")
seven_reset=$(reset_after "$reset7")
ctx_color=$(usage_color "$ctx")
five_color=$(usage_color "$used5")
seven_color=$(usage_color "$used7")

printf '%s[%s Â· %s]%s  ' "$MODEL_COLOR" "$model" "$effort" "$RESET"
context_bar "$ctx"
printf '  %s%s%s  %sâ%s  %sHit%s %s%s\n' "$ctx_color" "$ctx_label" "$RESET" "$SEPARATOR" "$RESET" "$CYAN" "$RESET" "$CYAN" "$hit_label"
printf '5h  %s%s%s left %sÂ·%s reset %s  %sâ%s  7d  %s%s%s left %sÂ·%s reset %s\n' \
  "$five_color" "$five_left" "$RESET" "$DIM" "$RESET" "$five_reset" "$SEPARATOR" "$RESET" \
  "$seven_color" "$seven_left" "$RESET" "$DIM" "$RESET" "$seven_reset"

using Microsoft.IdentityModel.JsonWebTokens;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;


namespace lbMcpJwtDemo;

public class JwtTokenService
{
    public const int AccessTokenLifetimeSeconds = 900;
    private readonly string _issuer;
    private readonly string _audience;
    private readonly SymmetricSecurityKey _key;

    public JwtTokenService(IConfiguration config)
    {
        _issuer = config["Jwt:Issuer"] ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Jwt:Issuer is required.");
        _audience = config["Jwt:Audience"] ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Jwt:Audience is required.");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_issuer) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_audience))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Jwt:Issuer and Jwt:Audience must not be empty.");

        var secret = config["Jwt:Secret"]
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Configure Jwt:Secret with dotnet user-secrets or the Jwt__Secret environment variable.");
        var bytes = new byte[secret.Length];
        if (!Convert.TryFromBase64String(secret, bytes, out var length) || length < 32)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Jwt:Secret must be Base64 encoded and contain at least 32 random bytes.");
        _key = new SymmetricSecurityKey(bytes[..length]);
    }

    public string CreateAccessToken(IdentityUser user)
    {
        // ç¨å­å¸ä¼  Claimsï¼JsonWebTokenHandler ä¼åæ ·åè¿ token
        var claims = new Dictionary<string, object>
        {
            [JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub] = user.Id,
            [JwtRegisteredClaimNames.UniqueName] = user.UserName ?? user.Id,
            [JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Jti] = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
            [JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Email] = user.Email ?? "",
            ["scope"] = "mcp:invoke"
        };

        var descriptor = new SecurityTokenDescriptor
        {
            Issuer = _issuer,
            Audience = _audience,
            Claims = claims,
            Expires = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(AccessTokenLifetimeSeconds),
            SigningCredentials = new SigningCredentials(_key, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256)
        };

        var handler = new JsonWebTokenHandler();
        return handler.CreateToken(descriptor);
    }

    public TokenValidationParameters CreateValidationParameters() => new()
    {
        ValidateIssuer = true,
        ValidateAudience = true,
        ValidateLifetime = true,
        ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
        ValidIssuer = _issuer,
        ValidAudience = _audience,
        IssuerSigningKey = _key,
        ValidAlgorithms = [SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256],
        NameClaimType = JwtRegisteredClaimNames.UniqueName,
        ClockSkew = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1)
    };
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace lbMcpJwtDemo;

[ApiController]
[AllowAnonymous]
[Route("api/auth")]
public class AuthController(
    AppDbContext db,
    UserManager<IdentityUser> userManager,
    SignInManager<IdentityUser> signInManager,
    JwtTokenService jwtTokenService,
    ILogger<AuthController> logger) : ControllerBase
{
    [HttpPost("register")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Register(RegisterRequest request)
    {
        var user = new IdentityUser { UserName = request.UserName, Email = request.Email };
        var result = await userManager.CreateAsync(user, request.Password);
        if (!result.Succeeded)
            return BadRequest(new { errors = result.Errors.Select(error => new { error.Code, error.Description }) });

        return StatusCode(StatusCodes.Status201Created, new { userId = user.Id, userName = user.UserName });
    }

    [HttpPost("login")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Login(LoginRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var user = await userManager.FindByNameAsync(request.UserName);
        if (user is null)
            return Unauthorized(new { error = "ç¨æ·åæå¯ç ä¸æ­£ç¡®" });

        var result = await signInManager.CheckPasswordSignInAsync(user, request.Password, lockoutOnFailure: true);
        if (!result.Succeeded)
        {
            logger.LogWarning("Login rejected. Locked out: {LockedOut}", result.IsLockedOut);
            return Unauthorized(new { error = "ç¨æ·åæå¯ç ä¸æ­£ç¡®ï¼æè´¦æ·å·²è¢«éå®" });
        }

        var refreshToken = AddRefreshToken(user.Id);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
        return Ok(CreateTokenResponse(user, refreshToken));
    }

    [HttpPost("refresh")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Refresh(RefreshRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // SQLite's immediate transaction serializes rotation and replay handling.
        await using var transaction = await db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(cancellationToken);
        var hash = TokenHasher.Hash(request.RefreshToken);
        var stored = await db.RefreshTokens.SingleOrDefaultAsync(token => token.TokenHash == hash, cancellationToken);
        if (stored is null)
            return Unauthorized(new { error = "æ æç refresh token" });

        if (stored.IsRevoked)
        {
            await db.RefreshTokens.Where(token => token.UserId == stored.UserId && !token.IsRevoked)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters.SetProperty(token => token.IsRevoked, true), cancellationToken);
            await transaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);
            logger.LogWarning("Refresh token replay detected; active refresh tokens revoked");
            return Unauthorized(new { error = "æ£æµå°éæ¾ï¼å·²åéè¯¥ç¨æ·ææ refresh token" });
        }

        var user = await userManager.FindByIdAsync(stored.UserId);
        if (stored.ExpiresAtUtc <= DateTime.UtcNow || user is null || await userManager.IsLockedOutAsync(user))
        {
            stored.IsRevoked = true;
            await db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
            await transaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);
            return Unauthorized(new { error = "refresh token å·²è¿ææè´¦æ·ä¸å¯ç¨" });
        }

        var refreshToken = AddRefreshToken(user.Id);
        stored.IsRevoked = true;
        stored.ReplacedByTokenHash = TokenHasher.Hash(refreshToken);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
        await transaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);
        return Ok(CreateTokenResponse(user, refreshToken));
    }

    [HttpPost("logout")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Logout(RefreshRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var hash = TokenHasher.Hash(request.RefreshToken);
        await db.RefreshTokens.Where(token => token.TokenHash == hash && !token.IsRevoked)
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters.SetProperty(token => token.IsRevoked, true), cancellationToken);
        return NoContent();
    }

    private string AddRefreshToken(string userId)
    {
        var token = Convert.ToBase64String(RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(64));
        db.RefreshTokens.Add(new RefreshToken
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            UserId = userId,
            TokenHash = TokenHasher.Hash(token),
            ExpiresAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(7)
        });
        return token;
    }

    private object CreateTokenResponse(IdentityUser user, string refreshToken) => new
    {
        accessToken = jwtTokenService.CreateAccessToken(user),
        refreshToken,
        tokenType = "Bearer",
        expiresIn = JwtTokenService.AccessTokenLifetimeSeconds
    };
}

using lbMcpJwtDemo;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.JsonWebTokens;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Add services to the container.
// Learn more about configuring OpenAPI at https://aka.ms/aspnet/openapi
builder.Services.AddOpenApi();
builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddProblemDetails();

var tokenService = new JwtTokenService(builder.Configuration);
builder.Services.AddSingleton(tokenService);

builder.Services.AddDbContext<AppDbContext>(options =>
    options.UseSqlite(builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("Default")));

builder.Services.AddIdentityCore<IdentityUser>(options =>
    {
        options.Lockout.MaxFailedAccessAttempts = 5;
        options.Lockout.DefaultLockoutTimeSpan = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);
    })
    .AddRoles<IdentityRole>()
    .AddEntityFrameworkStores<AppDbContext>()
    .AddSignInManager()
    .AddDefaultTokenProviders();

builder.Services.AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
    .AddJwtBearer(options =>
    {
        options.MapInboundClaims = false;
        options.TokenValidationParameters = tokenService.CreateValidationParameters();
    });
    
builder.Services.AddMcpServer()
    .WithHttpTransport()
    .WithTools<WeatherTool>();

builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("mcp", policy =>
    {
        policy.AddAuthenticationSchemes(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme);
        policy.RequireAuthenticatedUser();
        policy.RequireClaim("scope", "mcp:invoke");
    });
});


var app = builder.Build();

using (var scope = app.Services.CreateScope())
{
    var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>();
    await db.Database.EnsureCreatedAsync();
}

app.UseExceptionHandler();

// Configure the HTTP request pipeline.
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.MapOpenApi();
}

if (!app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseHsts();
    app.UseHttpsRedirection();
}
app.UseDefaultFiles();
app.UseStaticFiles();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

app.MapControllers();

app.MapGet("/api/auth/me", (System.Security.Claims.ClaimsPrincipal user) => Results.Ok(new
{
    userId = user.FindFirst(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub)?.Value,
    userName = user.Identity?.Name,
    email = user.FindFirst(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Email)?.Value
})).RequireAuthorization();

};

    var forecast =  Enumerable.Range(1, 5).Select(index =>
        new WeatherForecast
        (

            Random.Shared.Next(-20, 55),
            summaries[Random.Shared.Next(summaries.Length)]
        ))
        .ToArray();
    return forecast;
})
.WithName("GetWeatherForecast")
.RequireAuthorization();

app.Run();

record WeatherForecast(DateOnly Date, int TemperatureC, string? Summary)

void Attitude_ShowOnOled(void)

            dt_s = (float)((uint32_t)(tick_ms - read_last_ms)) * 0.001f;

}

 *   6. å¯å¨æå¤§å¢çï¼å 3 ç§å¿«éå¯¹åï¼ä¹åååæ­£å¸¸å¼

#include <math.h>

#define AHRS_KP                 0.5f
#define AHRS_KI_RATE            0.03f          /* ç§¯åå¢çï¼åä½ï¼æ¯ç§ï¼ä¹çæ¯ dt_s */
#define AHRS_STARTUP_KP        10.0f           /* å¯å¨æå¢çï¼ç»éªå¼ï¼è§æ­£æï¼ */
#define AHRS_STARTUP_MS      3000U             /* å¯å¨æå¤é¿ */
#define AHRS_ACC_ENTER_G        0.15f          /* æ¨¡é¿åç¦»è¶è¿è¿ä¸ªï¼å¤ä¸ºå¯ç */
#define AHRS_ACC_EXIT_G         0.10f          /* åå°è¿ä¸ªä»¥åï¼å¤ä¸ºå¯ä¿¡ */
#define AHRS_ACC_REJECT_MS     500U            /* è¿ç»­å¯çè¿ä¹ä¹ï¼éå°ä½å¯ä¿¡åº¦ */
#define AHRS_ACC_LOW_WEIGHT     0.25f          /* ä½å¯ä¿¡åº¦æ¶ kpãki é½ä¹è¿ä¸ª */

#define AHRS_DT_MAX_S           1.0f           /* åæé´éä¸éï¼è¶è¿å°±å½æ°æ®æ­äº */

typedef struct

    uint32_t   sample_count;   /* ä¸å±è·äºå¤å°æ */
    uint32_t   reject_count;   /* å éåº¦å¯ç/æ æçææ° */
    uint32_t   input_fault_count; /* è¾å¥ä¸åæ³ï¼æ´æä¸¢å¼çææ° */
    uint32_t   gyro_limit_count;  /* å¶ä¸­å ä¸ºéèºè¶éä¸¢ç */

/* æ¯æè°ä¸æ¬¡ãè¿å 1 è¡¨ç¤ºè¿ä¸æå§¿ææ´æ°äºï¼
 * è¿ä¸æææ²¡æç¨ä¸å éåº¦ï¼ç ahrs->accel_usedââä¸¤ä»¶äºåå¼ï¼å«ç¨ä¸ä¸ªè¿åå¼å¼çè¯´ */
uint8_t Ahrs_Update(Ahrs *ahrs, const Sensor_Data *sensor, float dt_s)
{
    float ax = sensor->accel_x_g;
    float ay = sensor->accel_y_g;
    float az = sensor->accel_z_g;
    float gx;
    float gy;
    float gz;
    float norm;
    float dev;
    float gravity_x;
    float gravity_y;
    float gravity_z;
    float error_x;
    float error_y;
    float error_z;
    float kp;
    float half_dt;
    float q0 = ahrs->q.w;
    float q1 = ahrs->q.x;
    float q2 = ahrs->q.y;
    float q3 = ahrs->q.z;
    float next_w;
    float next_x;
    float next_y;
    float next_z;
    uint32_t step_ms;
    float accel_weight = 0.0f;
    uint8_t accel_valid = 0U;
    uint8_t input_bad = 0U;
    uint8_t state_updated = 0U;

    ahrs->sample_count++;

    /* ä¸ãè¾å¥åéªä¸éãå¨æä¸åæ³ãéèºè¯»æ°ä¸æ¯æ°ï¼æ´æä¸¢å¼ */
    if ((!isfinite(dt_s)) || (dt_s <= 0.0f) || (dt_s > AHRS_DT_MAX_S) ||
        (!isfinite(sensor->gyro_x_dps)) || (!isfinite(sensor->gyro_y_dps)) ||
        (!isfinite(sensor->gyro_z_dps)))
    {
        input_bad = 1U;
    }
    else if ((fabsf(sensor->gyro_x_dps) > AHRS_GYRO_LIMIT_DPS) ||
             (fabsf(sensor->gyro_y_dps) > AHRS_GYRO_LIMIT_DPS) ||
             (fabsf(sensor->gyro_z_dps) > AHRS_GYRO_LIMIT_DPS))
    {
        input_bad = 2U;           /* é¥±åï¼æè½¦ãææ¨¡å */
    }
    else
    {
        input_bad = 0U;
    }

    if (input_bad != 0U)
    {
        ahrs->input_fault_count++;

        if (input_bad == 2U)
        {
            ahrs->gyro_limit_count++;
        }

        ahrs->integral_x = 0.0f;     /* è½¯éå¯ï¼ç§¯åä¸¢æï¼å«å¸¦çéé¶åç»§ç»­è· */
        ahrs->integral_y = 0.0f;
        ahrs->integral_z = 0.0f;

        return 0U;                   /* å§¿ææ²¡æ´æ° */
    }

    /* è¿ä¸æ­¥æ¾å¨æ£æ¥ä¹åï¼dt_s æ¯æ ç©·å¤§çæ¶åï¼è½¬ææ´æ°æ¯æªå®ä¹è¡ä¸º */
    step_ms = (uint32_t)(dt_s * 1000.0f);

    if (step_ms == 0U)

        step_ms = 1U;
    }

    /* äºãç¬¬ä¸éé¨ãææãï¼æ¨¡é¿ç®å¾åºæ¥ãä¸æ¯é¶åéãè¿éé¨æ°¸è¿ä¸æ¾å¼ */
    norm = sqrtf((ax * ax) + (ay * ay) + (az * az));

    if ((isfinite(norm)) && (norm > 0.001f))
    {

    }

    /* ä¸ãå¯ä¿¡åº¦ä¸æ¡£ï¼æ æ 0ãå¯çä¹äº 0.25ãå¯ä¿¡ 1 */
    if (accel_valid != 0U)
    {

        {

            accel_weight = 1.0f;
        }
        else
        {

            if (ahrs->reject_ms <= (0xFFFFU - step_ms))
            {

            }
            else
            {
                ahrs->reject_ms = 0xFFFFU;
            }

            ahrs->reject_count++;

            if (ahrs->reject_ms >= AHRS_ACC_REJECT_MS)
            {
                ahrs->reject_ms = AHRS_ACC_REJECT_MS;  /* åå¨è¿ä¸æ¡£ï¼ä¸åç´¯å  */
                accel_weight = AHRS_ACC_LOW_WEIGHT;
            }
        }
    }
    else
    {
        ahrs->reject_ms = 0U;
        ahrs->reject_count++;
        /* æ ææ°æ®æéæä¸º 0ï¼æ°¸è¿èµ°ä¸å°ä¸é¢çé¤æ³ */
    }

    ahrs->accel_used = (accel_weight > 0.0f) ? 1U : 0U;

    /* åãå¯å¨æç¨å¤§å¢çï¼å ç§åååæ­£å¸¸å¼ */
    kp = (ahrs->startup_left_ms > 0U) ? AHRS_STARTUP_KP : AHRS_KP;

    if (ahrs->startup_left_ms > 0U)
    {
        ahrs->startup_left_ms = (step_ms >= ahrs->startup_left_ms)
                              ? 0U : (ahrs->startup_left_ms - step_ms);
    }

    /* äºãè§éåº¦è½¬å¼§åº¦ãè¿éä¸åæ­»åºââæ¢éè½¬å¨æ¯çå®ä¿¡æ¯ */
    gx = sensor->gyro_x_dps * ATTITUDE_DEG_TO_RAD;
    gy = sensor->gyro_y_dps * ATTITUDE_DEG_TO_RAD;
    gz = sensor->gyro_z_dps * ATTITUDE_DEG_TO_RAD;

    /* å­ãææéä¿®æ­£ï¼å¯ççæ¶å kp å ki ä¸èµ·éï¼èä¸æ¯è¦ä¹å¨ä¿¡è¦ä¹å¨å³ */
    if (accel_weight > 0.0f)
    {
        ax /= norm;
        ay /= norm;
        az /= norm;

        gravity_x = 2.0f * ((q1 * q3) - (q0 * q2));
        gravity_y = 2.0f * ((q0 * q1) + (q2 * q3));
        gravity_z = 1.0f - (2.0f * ((q1 * q1) + (q2 * q2)));

        error_x = (ay * gravity_z) - (az * gravity_y);
        error_y = (az * gravity_x) - (ax * gravity_z);
        error_z = (ax * gravity_y) - (ay * gravity_x);

        gx += (kp * accel_weight * error_x) + ahrs->integral_x;
        gy += (kp * accel_weight * error_y) + ahrs->integral_y;
        gz += (kp * accel_weight * error_z) + ahrs->integral_z;

        /* ç§¯åæç§ç®ï¼æéä¸èµ·ä¹ï¼ä¸ä¿¡ä»»çæµéä¹ä¸è¯¥å¾ç§¯åéç */
        ahrs->integral_x += AHRS_KI_RATE * accel_weight * error_x * dt_s;
        ahrs->integral_y += AHRS_KI_RATE * accel_weight * error_y * dt_s;
        ahrs->integral_z += AHRS_KI_RATE * accel_weight * error_z * dt_s;

        if (ahrs->integral_x > AHRS_INTEGRAL_MAX)  { ahrs->integral_x = AHRS_INTEGRAL_MAX; }
        if (ahrs->integral_x < -AHRS_INTEGRAL_MAX) { ahrs->integral_x = -AHRS_INTEGRAL_MAX; }
        if (ahrs->integral_y > AHRS_INTEGRAL_MAX)  { ahrs->integral_y = AHRS_INTEGRAL_MAX; }
        if (ahrs->integral_y < -AHRS_INTEGRAL_MAX) { ahrs->integral_y = -AHRS_INTEGRAL_MAX; }
        if (ahrs->integral_z > AHRS_INTEGRAL_MAX)  { ahrs->integral_z = AHRS_INTEGRAL_MAX; }
        if (ahrs->integral_z < -AHRS_INTEGRAL_MAX) { ahrs->integral_z = -AHRS_INTEGRAL_MAX; }
    }

    /* ä¸ãä¸ç®¡å éåº¦ç¨ä¸ç¨ï¼éèºé½è¦æ¨ */
    half_dt = 0.5f * dt_s;

    next_w = q0 + (((-q1 * gx) - (q2 * gy) - (q3 * gz)) * half_dt);
    next_x = q1 + ((( q0 * gx) + (q2 * gz) - (q3 * gy)) * half_dt);
    next_y = q2 + ((( q0 * gy) - (q1 * gz) + (q3 * gx)) * half_dt);
    next_z = q3 + ((( q0 * gz) + (q1 * gy) - (q2 * gx)) * half_dt);

    /* å«ãå½ä¸åãå¤±è´¥å°±åå¨ä¸ä¸æââå§¿æçªç¶è·³åâæ²¡è½¬è¿âï¼æ¯å¸¦çè¯¯å·®æ´å±é© */
    norm = sqrtf((next_w * next_w) + (next_x * next_x) +
                 (next_y * next_y) + (next_z * next_z));

    if ((isfinite(norm)) && (norm > 0.000001f))
    {
        ahrs->q.w = next_w / norm;
        ahrs->q.x = next_x / norm;
        ahrs->q.y = next_y / norm;
        ahrs->q.z = next_z / norm;
        state_updated = 1U;
    }
    else
    {
        ahrs->norm_fault_count++;   /* è¿ä¸æä¸ç®ï¼å§¿æä»æ¯ä¸ä¸æçå¼ */
    }

    return state_updated;
}

/* ä¸ä¸ªè§å¨é¨ä»åä¸ç»ååæ°æ¢ç®ï¼ååé¢é£å¥å¬å¼ä¸å­ä¸å·® */
void Ahrs_GetEuler(const Ahrs *ahrs, Euler_Angle *angle)
{
    float q0 = ahrs->q.w;
    float q1 = ahrs->q.x;
    float q2 = ahrs->q.y;
    float q3 = ahrs->q.z;
    float vecx_z;

    vecx_z = 2.0f * ((q0 * q2) - (q1 * q3));

    if (vecx_z > 1.0f)       { vecx_z = 1.0f; }
    else if (vecx_z < -1.0f) { vecx_z = -1.0f; }

    angle->pitch = asinf(vecx_z) * ATTITUDE_RAD_TO_DEG;
    angle->roll  = atan2f(2.0f * ((q2 * q3) + (q0 * q1)),
                          1.0f - (2.0f * ((q1 * q1) + (q2 * q2)))) * ATTITUDE_RAD_TO_DEG;
    angle->yaw   = atan2f(2.0f * ((q0 * q3) + (q1 * q2)),
                          1.0f - (2.0f * ((q2 * q2) + (q3 * q3)))) * ATTITUDE_RAD_TO_DEG;
}

static float Wrap180(float deg)
{
